# Normalize using running stats
                        mean_val = float(running_mean[c])
                        var_val = float(running_var[c])
                        weight_val = float(weight[c])
                        bias_val = float(bias[c])
                        
                        # Ensure variance is positive for sqrt
                        var_val = max(abs(var_val), eps)
                        
                        normalized = (input_val - mean_val) / math.sqrt(var_val + eps)
                        # Scale and shift
                        output[b][c][h][w] = normalized * weight_val + bias_val
